root_text: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases are rising, sparking concerns. While not as widespread as COVID-19, HMPV can cause severe respiratory issues, especially in children and the elderly. Stay informed, stay safe! #HMPV #HealthAlert #StaySafe
